AYAN ARIF

Process Improvement Leader | Operational Transformation Leader | Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Gurgaon, Haryana, India | +91 9818155846 | ayan.arif25@gmail.com

| linkedin.com/in/ayanarif

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Process Improvement leader and Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with 10+ years of progressive experience in operations management, starting from high-volume customer operations at Virgin Media/Concentrix and advancing to process transformation leadership at American Express. Proven expertise executing end-to-end DMAIC projects (6–9-month complex initiatives), designing and implementing process re-engineering solutions, and leading cross-functional transformation across US and APAC geographies. Demonstrated capability in digital automation, data-driven analytics (Power BI, Qualtrics, dashboarding), and change management frameworks—enabling sustainable operational excellence at scale.

Flagship achievement: Led full-cycle DMAIC engagement to reduce enterprise process defects by 97% (1,500 → 35–45 cases/month), protected $2M+ in revenue exposure, released $2–3M in blocked working capital, and earned the AmEx Centurion Award 2024—the highest enterprise recognition at American Express. Core expertise spans process re-engineering, Lean Six Sigma project leadership, change management, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder governance, team transformation, and KPI-driven operational excellence.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Process Improvement s Methodology: Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt) · DMAIC Methodology · Process Re-engineering · Root Cause Analysis (RCA) · Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagrams · Pareto Analysis · Process Mapping · SOP Development · ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor

Digital, Automation s Analytics: KPI Dashboard Engineering · Data Visualization (Power BI, Excel) · Qualtrics (Voice of Customer) · Business Impact Quantification · AI Literacy (Google AI Professional) · Process Automation Fundamentals · Data-Driven Problem Solving

Operations s Leadership: Team Leadership · Stakeholder Management (cross-functional) · Project Delivery C Governance · Change Leadership · Crisis Management · Organizational Transformation

Domain Knowledge: Financial Services Operations · BFSI · Dispute Operations · KYC Operations · Customer Support Operations · High-Volume Operations at Scale

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

American Express June 2018 – January 2026

Team Leader — Process Improvement & Operational Transformation | Gurgaon, India

Led end-to-end process improvement initiatives and operational transformation across high-volume corporate card and KYC operations, combining Lean Six Sigma project leadership with operational stewardship of 25+ direct reports. Executed complex cross-functional DMAIC engagements spanning US and APAC geographies.

Flagship: Bad Demand Dispute Reduction — Full-Cycle DMAIC Project Leadership

Project Leader for comprehensive 6–9 month DMAIC engagement managing cross-functional teams across frontline representatives, SMEs, Quality, Legal, Risk C Compliance—demonstrating project delivery discipline, stakeholder governance, and milestone tracking.

Applied systematic problem-solving: Pareto Analysis isolated root causes (two ISO code categories drove 60% of defects); Fishbone diagrams and 5 Whys traced systemic drivers across People, Process, Knowledge, Systems, and Culture.

Delivered: 97% defect reduction (1,500 → 35–45 cases/month); $2M+ revenue protected; $2–3M blocked capital released. Implemented six improvement solutions: probing script redesign, ISO taxonomy clarification, embedded SME coaching, performance realignment, monitoring dashboards, knowledge overhaul.

Established Control phase governance: weekly reporting, quality audits, kaizen assessments, formal ownership transfer—preventing regression and institutionalizing continuous improvement. Earned AmEx Centurion Award 2024.

Process transformation: Applied Lean Six Sigma DMAIC methodology to redesign CDD/KYC work standards



across a 48,000+ case inventory, lifting individual analyst productivity by 60% (25 → 40 cases/day) while raising processing quality from 90% to 99% — achieved through standardization and coaching, with zero added headcount.

CDD/EDD-specific improvement: Led Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) workflow redesigns that cut KYC processing time by 25%, while sustaining 100% adherence to regulatory and audit requirements across all reporting cycles.



Operational Excellence & Transformation at Scale

Applied Lean Six Sigma to 48,000+ case inventory: 60% productivity uplift (25 → 40 cases/day), 90% → 99% quality improvement through work standardization and coaching, not additional headcount.

Managed operational scale: 48,000+ case inventory at 98.5% quality score, 7–8 Units Per Hour (UPH), 90%+ system occupancy within strict regulatory SLA requirements.

Designed 20+ SOPs spanning process categorization, escalation governance, regulatory compliance, customer communication, merchant verification—enabling consistent execution and reducing errors across distributed teams.

Crisis Leadership & Change Management

Managed GO2 tool implementation crisis (Jan 2024): escalations surged 200 → 500/month. Deployed 6-person escalation team, redesigned workflows, reduced escalations to 350/month (30% improvement)—demonstrating crisis response and process agility.

Led transformations: Voice of Customer (Qualtrics) analysis recovered CSAT (70% → 82%), NPS (70% → 90%), AHT (500s → 400s, 20% reduction). Designed Extended Payment Terms Plans for 30+ accounts (₹90 lakhs annual savings).

Team Leadership & Capability Building

Led 25+ representatives through coaching, performance reviews, KPI dashboards. Improved engagement 15%, maintained 85% retention, developed 5 internal promotion candidates.

Reduced new-hire time-to-productivity by 20% through onboarding protocols and knowledge transfer—demonstrating organizational capability and change enablement.

Encore Capital February 2017 – February 2018

Process Expert — Debt Collection Operations | Gurgaon, India

Managed end-to-end account recovery portfolios demonstrating expertise in high-volume operations management, process adherence, regulatory compliance (FDCPA), and stakeholder engagement in a regulated financial services environment.

Concentrix August 2015 – February 2017

Practitioner — Tech Support Operations (Virgin Media UK) | Gurgaon, India

Delivered technical support and customer service across high-volume Virgin Media UK operations, building foundational expertise in customer-centric service delivery, troubleshooting discipline, and operational procedures in a fast-paced, high-touch support environment.

CERTIFICATIONS & AWARDS

Centurion Award 2024 — American Express | Highest enterprise award for business impact and process transformation.

Process Excellence: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB) · Lean Six Sigma Green Belt · ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor · Total Quality Management (TQM)

Digital s AI: Google AI Professional · Google Foundations of Project Management

EDUCATION

(B.Tech) — Computer Science s Engineering | Rajasthan Technical University | Jun 2009 – Aug 2013

Relevant Coursework: Data Structures · DBMS · System Design · Algorithm Design

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
American Express June 2018 – January 2026
Team Leader — Process Improvement & Operational Transformation | Gurgaon, India
Led end-to-end process improvement initiatives and operational transformation across high-volume corporate card and KYC operations, combining Lean Six Sigma project leadership with operational stewardship of 25+ direct reports. Executed complex cross-functional DMAIC engagements spanning US and APAC geographies.
Flagship: Bad Demand Dispute Reduction — Full-Cycle DMAIC Project Leadership
Project Leader for comprehensive 6–9 month DMAIC engagement managing cross-functional teams across frontline representatives, SMEs, Quality, Legal, Risk C Compliance—demonstrating project delivery discipline, stakeholder governance, and milestone tracking.
Applied systematic problem-solving: Pareto Analysis isolated root causes (two ISO code categories drove 60% of defects); Fishbone diagrams and 5 Whys traced systemic drivers across People, Process, Knowledge, Systems, and Culture.
Delivered: 97% defect reduction (1,500 → 35–45 cases/month); $2M+ revenue protected; $2–3M blocked capital released. Implemented six improvement solutions: probing script redesign, ISO taxonomy clarification, embedded SME coaching, performance realignment, monitoring dashboards, knowledge overhaul.
Established Control phase governance: weekly reporting, quality audits, kaizen assessments, formal ownership transfer—preventing regression and institutionalizing continuous improvement. Earned AmEx Centurion Award 2024.
Process transformation: Applied Lean Six Sigma DMAIC methodology to redesign CDD/KYC work standards
across a 48,000+ case inventory, lifting individual analyst productivity by 60% (25 → 40 cases/day) while raising processing quality from 90% to 99% — achieved through standardization and coaching, with zero added headcount.
CDD/EDD-specific improvement: Led Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) workflow redesigns that cut KYC processing time by 25%, while sustaining 100% adherence to regulatory and audit requirements across all reporting cycles.
Operational Excellence & Transformation at Scale
Applied Lean Six Sigma to 48,000+ case inventory: 60% productivity uplift (25 → 40 cases/day), 90% → 99% quality improvement through work standardization and coaching, not additional headcount.
Managed operational scale: 48,000+ case inventory at 98.5% quality score, 7–8 Units Per Hour (UPH), 90%+ system occupancy within strict regulatory SLA requirements.
Designed 20+ SOPs spanning process categorization, escalation governance, regulatory compliance, customer communication, merchant verification—enabling consistent execution and reducing errors across distributed teams.
Crisis Leadership & Change Management
Managed GO2 tool implementation crisis (Jan 2024): escalations surged 200 → 500/month. Deployed 6-person escalation team, redesigned workflows, reduced escalations to 350/month (30% improvement)—demonstrating crisis response and process agility.
Led transformations: Voice of Customer (Qualtrics) analysis recovered CSAT (70% → 82%), NPS (70% → 90%), AHT (500s → 400s, 20% reduction). Designed Extended Payment Terms Plans for 30+ accounts (₹90 lakhs annual savings).
Team Leadership & Capability Building
Led 25+ representatives through coaching, performance reviews, KPI dashboards. Improved engagement 15%, maintained 85% retention, developed 5 internal promotion candidates.
Reduced new-hire time-to-productivity by 20% through onboarding protocols and knowledge transfer—demonstrating organizational capability and change enablement.
Encore Capital February 2017 – February 2018
Process Expert — Debt Collection Operations | Gurgaon, India
Managed end-to-end account recovery portfolios demonstrating expertise in high-volume operations management, process adherence, regulatory compliance (FDCPA), and stakeholder engagement in a regulated financial services environment.
Concentrix August 2015 – February 2017
Practitioner — Tech Support Operations (Virgin Media UK) | Gurgaon, India
Delivered technical support and customer service across high-volume Virgin Media UK operations, building foundational expertise in customer-centric service delivery, troubleshooting discipline, and operational procedures in a fast-paced, high-touch support environment.
(B.Tech) — Computer Science s Engineering | Rajasthan Technical University | Jun 2009 – Aug 2013
Relevant Coursework: Data Structures · DBMS · System Design · Algorithm Design
